name: Sri Hanuman Temple (Ramagundam)
town_description: Ramagundam is a municipal-corporation city in Peddapalli district, Telangana, on the Godavari river, about 225 km northeast of Hyderabad. Known as the 'Coal City' and 'City of Black Gold' for its Singareni collieries and the NTPC Ramagundam thermal power complex, with Godavarikhani as its twin township. The city's name is traditionally linked to Lord Rama: 'Gundam' (water springs) in the old part of the city are said to have formed from Rama's footprints.
